K: bc_CreatureEndOfTurn L1264 bc_CreatureAttack damage-reduction argument RValue 2.0 (= 98%) lea rdx @0x140b04970 -> static RValue -100.0 @0x1498e12d0 (= 200%, the Rend and Tear scale); disp @0x140b04973. vs bugged: stronger. 2026-10-26: built as byte patch SU-0051 (verified against the baseline exe; not yet run in game).

release_notes.intended: At the end of each enemy's turn, it is forced to attack one of its allies for 200% normal damage.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the forced attack dealt 98% of normal damage.
release_notes.fix: Now the forced attack deals 200% normal damage.
